title: Πάνδα καὶ τὸ βιβλίον
learning_goal: This story emphasizes emotions (λυπέομαι, χαίρω) and the verbs δίδωμι and ἀναγινώσκω with present tense third person forms.
plot: A sad panda receives a book from her teacher and becomes happy while reading it.

frames.text: ἡ Πάνδα καθίζει παρὰ τὴν σχολήν. λυπεῖται.
positioning: Panda sits on the swing looking downward. She is sad and crying.

frames.text: ὁ διδάσκαλος ἔρχεται. δίδωσι βιβλίον τῇ Πάνδᾳ.
objects: A small leather-bound book with bronze clasps and parchment pages
positioning: Panda sits on the swing looking up hopefully at the teacher
Didaskalos stands beside Panda extending the book toward her with a gentle smile, shown from three-quarter view

frames.text: ἡ Πάνδα χαίρει καὶ ἀναγινώσκει τὸ βιβλίον.
objects: A small leather-bound book with bronze clasps and parchment pages
positioning: Panda sits upright holding the open book in her paws, looking down at the pages with a bright, joyful expression

frames.text: ὁ κόραξ ἔρχεται καὶ κλέπτει τὸ βιβλίον.
objects: A small leather-bound book with bronze clasps and parchment pages
positioning: Panda sits looking startled as her book is taken
Korax swoops down from above, grabbing the book in his beak, wings spread wide, shown from side view

frames.text: ἡ Πάνδα λυπεῖται πάλιν. οὐκ ἔχει τὸ βιβλίον.
positioning: Panda sits with her paws empty, looking down sadly with tears in her eyes

frames.text: ἰδού! ὁ ὑπερβρέφος ἔρχεται. φέρει τὸν κόρακα πρὸς τὴν Πάνδαν.
objects: A small leather-bound book with bronze clasps and parchment pages
positioning: Hyperbrephos crawls forward powerfully, dragging Korax by the wing
Korax is being pulled along reluctantly, still holding the book in his beak, looking annoyed

frames.text: ὁ κόραξ δίδωσι τὸ βιβλίον τῇ Πάνδᾳ.
objects: A small leather-bound book with bronze clasps and parchment pages
positioning: Panda reaches out to receive the book, looking grateful
Korax reluctantly extends the book toward Panda, looking sheepish
Hyperbrephos sits nearby watching with arms crossed, making sure Korax complies

frames.text: ὁ ὑπερβρέφος φέρει τὸν κόρακα ἐκ τῆς σχολῆς.
objects: A small leather-bound book with bronze clasps and parchment pages
positioning: Panda sits contentedly holding her book again, waving goodbye
Hyperbrephos crawls away dragging Korax by the wing toward the edge of the frame
Korax is being pulled along looking defeated and embarrassed

frames.text: ἡ Πάνδα χαίρει καὶ ἀναγινώσκει τὸ βιβλίον πάλιν.
objects: A small leather-bound book with bronze clasps and parchment pages
positioning: Panda sits peacefully reading the open book, with a content smile on her face
